channel.title: HSJ - Latest news
channel.description: Custom RSS feed for HSJ latest news

item.title: Trusts face £900m bill to end zero-hours contracts, employers warn
item.description: Government attempts to crack down on “exploitative” zero-hours contracts could adversely affect bank staff and cost the NHS £900m a year, the body representing NHS workforce leaders has claimed.

item.title: Governor claims he was intimidated ‘for reposting HSJ articles’
item.description: A governor has accused the leadership of a major hospital trust of seeking to “intimidate” him by launching a probe into his social media posts.

item.title: Pioneer CEO: ‘IHOs won’t fix all ills’
item.description: The CEO of a leading trust that is set to begin a “phased” launch of an integrated health organisation has warned the model should not be expected to “fix the ills of everything”.

item.title: In-house EPRs can avoid ‘phenomenal’ costs, says top CEO
item.description: A leading hospital chief executive has championed in-house NHS technology that costs “a fraction” of major commercial systems – and said she does not use the federated data platform.

item.title: £2.8bn trust group unravels
item.description: Three Midlands hospital trusts are unravelling their shared chair and CEO arrangement.

item.title: Supplier boss disqualified after body parts scandal
item.description: Garry Pettigrew disqualified for nine years after clinical waste scandal Criminal charges were dropped in 2023 HSJ reported in 2018 a massive build-up of clinical waste, including body parts The boss of a firm which HSJ exposed as stockpiling hundreds of tonnes of clinical waste – including human ...

item.title: GPs and governors call for trust group to split
item.description: Local GPs have joined calls from governors and consultants to break up a controversial partnership between two trusts.

item.title: Four hospitals hit by strike in overtime dispute
item.description: Hundreds of operating theatre staff are to strike at four hospitals in Greater Manchester due to a dispute around overtime payments.

item.title: NHS breeds leaders who are ‘too insular’, says ex-ICB chief
item.description: The NHS has some of the best leaders in the public service, but they often have a mindset that is too insular, according to a former ICB chief and senior civil servant.

item.title: Trusts cancel joint staff service with neighbours
item.description: Three trusts have cancelled a joint occupational health service after a row over standards.

item.title: Revealed: Dozens of maternity units at risk of closure
item.description: A national NHS leader has told HSJ he expects more maternity units to close, while analysis suggests dozens face similar problems to a hospital where births were suspended this month.

item.title: Trust must pay sacked director £120k
item.description: A trust director who was sacked after a “deeply flawed” investigation will receive an award of nearly £120,000 from his former employer.

item.title: NHSE director to run NHS Online
item.description: The country’s first digital-only NHS trust has appointed an NHS England regional director as its first chief executive.

item.title: ‘Serious failure of governance’ at ‘coach crash’ GP practice
item.description: The last remaining partner at a collapsing GP practice has admitted a “serious failure of governance” and likened its problems to a “coach crash”.

item.title: Coroner warns of staff shortage after inpatient death
item.description: A coroner has warned that more people could die because of a shortage of dietitians for psychiatric inpatients, after the death of a woman whose nutritional needs went unmet.

item.title: Fresh delay as ICB staff await compulsory redundancy
item.description: Around 50 staff facing compulsory redundancy in an integrated care board cluster have complained of a two-month delay as they wait for NHS England to sign off their departures.

item.title: Senior staff told to improve behaviour after bullying and racism findings
item.description: A trust has called for “tangible improvements” in behaviour from some of its senior clinicians, after an external review reported bullying, harassment, and racism.

item.title: Exclusive: Watchdog links patient deaths to controversial NHSE policy
item.description: A watchdog has called for a pause in the rollout of NHS England’s “advice and guidance” policy to protect safety, and linked it to two patient deaths, HSJ can reveal.

item.title: Trusts pilot schemes to cut single-use products
item.description: At least 20 NHS trusts will pilot a government scheme to cut back on single-use products and increase the use of reusable alternatives for widely used items such as tourniquets, blood pressure cuffs and sharps bins.

item.title: Revealed: The trusts that failed to sign up to NHSE’s financial plans
item.description: Ten trusts and one integrated care board had still not provided financially compliant plans for 2026-27 by the end of the first quarter, according to NHS England’s latest data.
